manifest.title: Trump says U.S. and Canada reached deal to delay 50% U.S. tariffs on Canadian imports
manifest.summary: President Trump said he was delaying the 50% U.S. tariffs on Canadian imports after the two countries reached a last-minute deal less than two hours before the sanctions were to go into effect.

manifest.title: Key results from Florida primaries, so far
manifest.summary: Voters in Florida are picking their party's candidates for governor, Senate and a number of U.S. House seats after redistricting.

manifest.title: Embattled Florida Republican Rep. Cory Mills loses his fight to keep his House seat
manifest.summary: Mills is the latest lawmaker in a recent string of congressional members facing scandals and allegations of domestic abuse while trying to run for elected office.

manifest.title: ABC and Disney sue FCC, alleging First Amendment violations
manifest.summary: The ABC network has sued the Federal Communications Commission, alleging that the Trump administration is violating its First Amendment rights by challenging ABC broadcast licenses and investigating the network's talk show The View.

manifest.title: 'Profits won.' The child safety trial against Meta kicks off in federal court
manifest.summary: Opening arguments are underway in a trial that pits four states against the company that owns Facebook and Instagram. They allege that Meta knew its products could hook kids — and lied about the danger.

manifest.title: S. Korea stresses US alliance amid confusion over Trump drill cut
manifest.summary: Lee's comments Tuesday come as many South Koreans remain baffled and concerned about U.S. President Donald Trump's abrupt order to "substantially reduce" military exercises with South Korea.

manifest.title: U.S. and Iran miss peace talks deadline. And, Alaska, Florida and Wyoming primaries
manifest.summary: The U.S. and Iran missed a deadline to begin peace talks this week. The monthslong war has depleted U.S. resources. And, what to know about Alaska's U.S. Senate seat primary.

manifest.title: The grueling fight over who profits from AI music
manifest.summary: AI can generate songs in seconds. But behind every AI track is a complicated question: Who should get paid? And, how? The fights have started.

manifest.title: In Portland, this soap box derby combines downhill speed with extreme pageantry
manifest.summary: Soap box derbies send motorless cars down a steep incline. At one event, contestants make their cars look like cartoon characters, subway cars, food, and giant animals (among other outlandish shapes).

manifest.title: She told no one about her agony except ChatGPT. What her death reveals about AI risks
manifest.summary: A 29-year-old woman confided her suicidal thoughts to an AI chatbot — not to her therapist, not to her parents, not to her best friend. What can AI learn from her death?
